messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (gerd) such as heartburn in adults and children 1 year of age and older"
set: ["symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (gerd) such as heartburn in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)", "erosive esophagitis in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "erosive esophagitis caused by acid reflux in adults and children 1 month of age and older", "gastroesophageal reflux disease", "children 2 years of age and older", "adults and children 15 and older", "adults and children 3 years and older", "adults and children", "adults 65 and older", "rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)", "type 2 diabetes in adults and children aged 10 years and older", "immediate relief of heartburn symptoms", "children of any age", "1 year", "children 10 years and older"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
